entries.text: This scan turned up 27 issues on 27 elements across 5 pages, and all of them are critical or serious (5 critical, 22 serious). Fix the footer social links first: in src/Shell.jsx the three social anchors (lines 30-32) wrap only a hidden icon, so a screen reader announces nothing for them — giving them names in that one shared footer clears all 15 of those issues at once. Next, the footer timestamp beside them is a light grey on white that is too faint to read; one style change there clears 5 more. The rest are unnamed buttons, an image with no description, and unlabelled form fields.
